run_read_h5s_default: run the script to read and display all H5 files in the current directory with default glob pattern
run_read_h5s_custom_dir: run the script with a custom data directory path to inspect H5 files in a specific folder
run_read_h5s_custom_template: run the script with a custom glob template to filter which H5 files to read and display
review_main_function: review the main function that iterates over H5 files and prints task names, demo status, and keys for each episode
summarize_h5_inspection: summarize the H5 file inspection workflow that extracts task names, RGB images, demo status, and dataset keys
